Fabio hit the box-resize ceiling in the app: under overflow the SIZE is still capped at one image span (cropTool _resize Math.min(w,1)), so a square box on a 768-wide image stops at 768x768 and cannot grow to take in the hair. Tracing it surfaced the root: under overflow the overlay canvas is the PADDED stage and _getContentBounds letterboxes the media into the canvas, scaling it up by the pad - so the drawn box is ~18% larger than the pixels it reports.
